import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inputStr = scanner.nextLine();
        String content = inputStr.substring(1, inputStr.length() - 1);
        int lengthContent = content.length();
        StringBuilder outputStr = new StringBuilder();
        outputStr.append(inputStr.charAt(0));
        int position = 0;
        boolean atFound = false;

        while (position < lengthContent) {
            if (position + 3 <= lengthContent) {
                if (content.substring(position, position + 3).equals("dot")) {
                    outputStr.append(".");
                    position += 3;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (position + 2 <= lengthContent && !atFound) {
                if (content.substring(position, position + 2).equals("at")) {
                    outputStr.append("@");
                    atFound = true;
                    position += 2;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            outputStr.append(content.charAt(position));
            position++;
        }
        outputStr.append(inputStr.charAt(inputStr.length() - 1));
        System.out.println(outputStr.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
